KTR appears before ACB court in Formula E case; hearing adjourned to August 25

Telangana Chief Minister K. Chandrashekar Rao appeared before the Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) court on Tuesday, where he was questioned about his alleged involvement in a Formula E race case. The hearing was adjourned until August 25. KTR was accompanied by three other individuals. The ACB had summoned KTR and others under Section 13 of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988, for allegedly accepting a bribe of ₹50 lakhs from a businessman in connection with the Formula E race held in Hyderabad last year.
